podcast.body: Released in 2014, *The Hum* is an album by this "noise rock band from Leeds, England." The album features the track "Unleaving" and exemplifies how contemporary bands are carrying on the shoegaze tradition. "In 2014, they released a record called The Humb."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
